spanish: Desnudez de tu hermana, hija de tu padre o hija de tu madre, nacida casa o nacida fuera, no descubrirás su desnudez.

findings.issue: מוֹלֶדֶת is a common feminine singular construct noun twice, governing the absolute nouns בַּיִת and חוּץ. 'nacida casa' / 'nacida fuera' turns that noun into a passive participle and drops the construct 'of', so house and outside are no longer its genitives.
The suffix is 3rd feminine plural. 'su' does not mark plural and, with singular 'hermana', reads as one woman's nakedness.

notes: Desnudez, hermana, hija, padre, o, madre, לא, and piel imperfect 2ms descubrir stay inside the tokens.
